deterministic 400/404 behavior: prove no retry and no automatic cross-provider traffic when the error is deterministic/non-fallback-eligible

401/403, model incompatibility, response-shape, and other reachable non-outage errors: prove they do not degrade provider health or trigger unintended provider rerouting, while half-open reachability semantics remain truthful

429 + Retry-After: verify bounded retry timing semantics, global execution-gate interaction, retry counters, and that no duplicate provider-health accounting occurs

caller cancellation during an in-flight provider call: prove no extra retry/provider fallback is sent after abort, cancellation is not recorded as provider-health failure, and lifecycle failed metadata reports aborted=true without exposing abort reason text
caller cancellation during retry delay: prove the delay is interruptible, no later retry/fallback request is sent, and retry/provider-health counters remain truthful

fallback ordering and explicit stickiness: validate provider/model fallback order against observed traffic, preserve explicit provider/model no-reroute behavior, and validate configured first-choice ordering before health observations

circuit behavior: force one backup through provider-level failures, prove exclusion during cooldown, exactly one half-open no-store recovery attempt after cooldown, fresh success closes, fresh outage failure reopens, and concurrent callers do not admit a second probe

trace and lifecycle reconciliation: compare VisionResult.trace or VisionError.trace, lifecycle started/completed/failed events, and deterministic stub request logs for providerCalls, payloadBytes, cacheHits, retries, modelFallbacks, providerFallbacks, splits, aborted state, and exactly-once terminal lifecycle emission; lifecycle observer exceptions must not alter adapter outcome or create traffic

usage reconciliation: for Chat Completions and Responses local stubs with explicit usage payloads, prove returned inputTokens/outputTokens match provider-reported values; for split calls, usage equals the sum of successful child calls and is never guessed

model discovery: verify configured/discovered model normalization and endpoint discovery behavior for supported compatible endpoints without leaking credentials into cache keys, logs, routes, or diagnostics

acceptance_criteria: Task Contract validates before execution and exact source SHA is recorded; all implementation/test changes are Codex-owned on one task branch/PR.
Chat Completions and Responses protocol parsing, usage, retries, model override, and error mapping are covered by deterministic tests and observed local traffic.
Non-OpenAI compatible endpoints never receive OpenAI-specific detail fields unless their declared protocol explicitly supports them.
Task-aware output budgets obey task defaults and the provider hard cap min(taskBudget, providerCap).
Deterministic 400/404, 401/403, model-incompatibility, response-shape, and explicit provider/model cases preserve no-reroute and provider-health semantics required by the contract.
413 recursive split preserves original image numbering and reconciles split/provider-call/payload/usage counters with observed child requests.
429 Retry-After, execution-gate behavior, retries, and provider-health accounting are truthful and non-duplicative.
In-flight and retry-delay cancellation sends no post-abort retry/fallback traffic, does not penalize provider health, and emits truthful aborted lifecycle evidence.
Provider fallback ordering, circuit open/cooldown/half-open exactly-one probe, fresh success, and fresh failure match observed traffic without semantic-cache false health.
VisionResult/VisionError trace, lifecycle events, and usage counters reconcile with deterministic provider logs; lifecycle observers are isolated from request outcomes.

Batch 011 main-model/composer/call-card PARTIAL items are retried in an isolated deterministic main-model rc.1 environment and either pass or are truthfully attributed to a concrete host/upstream blocker without fabricating PASS evidence.

Any explicitly available real-provider checks use minimal calls, expose no secrets, and are clearly separated from deterministic stub evidence; absence of credentials never authorizes reading real Harness settings.
All focused and full repository/package/built tests plus final task-branch CI pass after fixes, with no secret-bearing or unrelated changes.
Result Contract v2 uses second-precision timezone-aware timestamps, truthful per-check statuses, validator-owned --stamp evidence, and records blockers for any required unresolved host/upstream item.

On completion delete docs/agent-tasks/ACTIVE_TASK.json on the execution branch, commit/push the implementation/tests/Result plus ACTIVE task deletion, keep the PR unmerged, and stop without self-assigning Batch 015.
